title: kaijutsu Lockfile
description: Schema for kaijutsu.lock.json — pinned, reproducible resolution of kaijutsu.json. Updated by `jutsu install` and `jutsu upgrade`.

version.description: Skill's internal version from its skill.yaml (the `version:` field). Null when the skill ships only SKILL.md without a kaijutsu manifest.

tag.description: Registry tag the skill was resolved from (e.g. 'v0.3.1'). Empty when the skill was resolved from a default-branch HEAD or installed via --registry.

source.description: Owner/repo identifier (e.g. momentmaker/kaijutsu) or full URL for non-GitHub sources.

ref.description: Git commit SHA the lockfile pins to (or 'local' for --registry mode).

path.description: Directory inside the source repo where the skill lives (e.g., 'skills/core/decide'). Empty for repo-root layouts.

integrity.description: SHA-256 of the fetched tarball, prefixed sha256-.

installedAs.description: 'direct' for user-requested installs; 'dep:<parent>' for transitive dependencies.
